create materialized view mv_note_task_link as select distinct n.note_id, t.task_id from note n inner join rich_text rt on rt.rich_text_id = n.rich_text_id and rt.passive_id is null inner join username un on un.related_object_id = n.workspace_id and un.passive_id is null cross join lateral regexp_matches(rt.value, 'href="(?:https?://[^/"]+)?/([^/"]+)/task/([A-Za-z0-9]+)-([0-9]+)"', 'g') as link inner join team tm on tm.workspace_id = n.workspace_id and lower(tm.tag) = lower(link[2]) and tm.passive_id is null inner join task t on t.team_id = tm.team_id and t.team_tag_no = cast(link[3] as integer) and t.passive_id is null where n.passive_id is null and lower(un.username) = lower(link[1]);
create unique index idx_mv_note_task_link_note_id_task_id on mv_note_task_link (note_id, task_id); create index idx_mv_note_task_link_task_id on mv_note_task_link (task_id);
